title: I lost my last paying client and decided to go all in on my brick breaking roguelike mining game, am I making a terrible mistake?
author: mattmirrorfish

comments.author: Livid_Shallot5701
comments.body: For financial success? Definitely. Should have gone for a strong Player Fantasy in a popular Genre.

replies.author: mattmirrorfish
replies.body: Real. I did do some market research and saw that there seemed to be demand for mining games but then I might have gone off the rails with the roguelike hybrid nature of it kinda muddying the waters.

replies.author: cckynv
replies.body: fwiw, roguelikes are a very popular genre currently

replies.author: mattmirrorfish
replies.body: Yeah I’m a longtime roguelike player and dev for sure, my fave genre
